note: A part that a file names by manufacturer and part number is now matched to the parts catalogue when you open it - RockSim names every component, and desktop OpenRocket tags any part picked from its database - and the catalogue fills in whatever the file left unset. The file's own values always stand, and the catalogue never overrides the file's mass. The case this exists for is a parachute: RockSim writes a drag coefficient of 0.75 to mean automatic, so a Fruity Chutes Iris Ultra opened from a .rkt descended at the default 0.8 instead of its rated 2.2 and failed the 20 ft/s landing check on a correctly built rocket. Re-open any .rkt whose chute came from a catalogue. Also: balsa transitions picked from the catalogue are now solid (they applied as hollow 2 mm shells, up to 4.5x light - re-pick them and expect mass and CG to move); a RockSim shock cord no longer imports at ten times its mass; and the What's New list has its missing v0.095 and v0.096 entries.
